subject: AxiomWorks reference design: scope & test matrix

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: AxiomWorks reference design: scope & test matrix

Hi Maya / Paul —

Thanks again for taking the time last week. As discussed, I pulled together a concise reference-design proposal and the initial test matrix so we can validate end-to-end behavior before the marketplace listing. Main asks from our side:

- Confirm which AxiomWorks environment we can use for the POC (staging URL + SSH/VPN details).
- Confirm target RPS and 95th/99th latency targets you want us to validate for the canary.
- Agree which data flows will be used for quality checks (sample prompts, expected embeddings/outputs).

Attached is a first-pass document that maps Redwood’s hosting variants (hosted / dedicated / private) to the integration touchpoints, plus a proposed stress-testing cadence and rollback criteria. Suggest we run a technical dry-run next Tuesday (Jun 23) and a full stress run the following week.

Attachments: axiom-test-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet), axiomworks-ref-design-v1.pdf (reference design)

Proposed immediate next step: 30-min sync Wednesday to finalize the test window. Please propose times.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai

Thanks Aditya — this looks great and very pragmatic.

We can provide a staging cluster (staging.axiomworks.com) and open a temporary VPN user for your engineers. I'll send the VPN onboarding steps in a separate secure note. For load targets: our success criteria for this POC are 200 rps sustained with 95th < 220ms and graceful degradation under burst to 500 rps.

A few clarifying points:
- We will seed a small subset of anonymized production traces for quality checks; expect about ~10k sample prompts.
- We need a brief security checklist completed before we enable the VPN (SOC excerpt + IP allowlist).

Paul and I are generally available Wednesday 10:00–12:00 PT or Thursday 14:00–16:00 PT for the 30-min sync.

Regards,
Maya Kulkarni
Director, Integrations — AxiomWorks
maya@axiomworks.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Kulkarni <maya@axiomworks.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 08:12:05 -0700
Subject: Re: AxiomWorks reference design: scope & test matrix

Maya — thanks. A couple of technical notes from the runtime side before we lock the test plan:

- For the staging run, please provision a node with NVMe-backed storage and at least 64GB RAM so we can exercise prefix caching under realistic memory pressure.
- We'll use two model variants during the canary: a quantized 4-bit candidate for cost-benchmarks and an FP16 baseline for quality gating. Expect small latency differences; we'll report both token-level latency and end-to-end latency per request.
- Please add these IPs to your allowlist: 34.82.101.12, 34.82.101.13.

If you can share the sample prompts ahead of the dry run we can pre-generate KV cache warmups. Also propose an optional pairing session for our infra engineers on Jun 22 at 11:00 PT to walk the deployment scripts and VPN handoff.

On the security checklist: Laura, can you confirm whether Redwood can share the SOC excerpt and the minimal audit logs required?

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Kulkarni <maya@axiomworks.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AxiomWorks reference design: scope & test matrix

Maya / Paul —

Thanks for the quick confirmation and the target numbers — that's helpful. I've updated the reference PDF with the canary schedule and rollback thresholds (see v1 in the attachment). High-level plan:

1) Dry run (Jun 23): smoke tests, basic connectivity, KV warmup, correctness checks using the 10k prompt set.
2) Canary (Jun 25–26): ramp to 200 rps, run sequential 2-hour plateau windows at 50%, 100%, then 250% of target to observe degradation.
3) Stress day (Jun 29): extended burst scenarios up to 500 rps and abuse-case injection (long prompt chains, malformed payloads).

Rollback / abort triggers (examples):
- error rate > 2% sustained for 5 minutes
- 99th percentile latency above 800ms for more than 5 minutes
- any sign of data leakage in logs (immediate abort)

I've attached an updated PDF and the worksheet. Also added a DocuSign link for the temporary test addendum so Legal can confirm the data handling terms quickly. If the VPN onboarding and SOC excerpt are ready, we can proceed with the pairing session on Jun 22 at 11:00 PT.

Attachments: axiomworks-ref-design-v1.pdf (updated)
Links: https://www.docusign.com/recipient?doc=AW-ref-design-v1

Best,
Aditya
[attachment: axiomworks-ref-design-v1.pdf (application/pdf)]
